name: CPI day: fade the 08:30 reaction at the cash open
why: The 08:30 print lands on the thin overnight book: algos and stops run the price, and when the cash market opens real money reprices the number. 2026-10-17 map (real BLS dates): the 08:29->08:45 move vs the RTH open->close is corr -0.33 on CPI days 2010-20 and -0.23 since 2021, +0.03 on days without news. Pre-registered; holdout 2025-01 on judged once.
